title: Write unit tests for slugify.py
desc: Write unit tests for slugify.py in tests/test_slugify.py using standard library unittest only (no pip installs). Cover slugify (normal text, punctuation, max_len) and parse_duration (valid and invalid input). Run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v through hermes-crew verify so the result is recorded. If a test shows a real bug in slugify.py, do NOT edit slugify.py: tell the lead what you found.

title: Review tests/test_slugify.py and verify test suite
desc: Read tests/test_slugify.py and slugify.py, run the tests yourself (hermes-crew verify python -m unittest discover -s tests -v), and decide whether the tests are meaningful (they must assert behaviour, not just call the functions). Approve the test file with hermes-crew board approve tests/test_slugify.py '<what was checked>', or send Engineer a short list of fixes.
